reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports the conclusion: § 4.1 (p0052) and § 4.2 (p0054) address only Charges specification, invoicing and currency, with no pricing-parity or third-party-matching language, and § 14.16 (p0200) expressly leaves each party free to contract with others rather than imposing any obligation on Customer to extend IBM terms given to third parties.

Under the MFN rule, absence of any MFN obligation burdening Customer is the preferred position; the rationale correctly notes that the lack of a Vendor-granted MFN in our favour is an upside item, not a deviation, so no redline is warranted.
Rendered redline is byte-identical to the originals, consistent with the compliant classification, and no deterministic checks failed.
